summary: Joseph, Australian, software engineer with 17 years of programming experience, former Google Wave developer, author of ShareJS, strong advocate for open-source software, prefers functional programming paradigms, critical of traditional OOP, interested in operational transformation and real-time collaborative editing, has a background in teaching programming, passionate about improving developer experience and software security, engaged in discussions about privacy and data ownership, enjoys exploring new programming languages and technologies, has a keen interest in the intersection of technology and society, actively participates in online tech communities, and has a history of working on projects related to web development and real-time applications.
